title: Far from home, Voyager 1 will soon be a 'light-day' from Earth
summary: NASA's Voyager 1, which is the furthest human-made object from Earth, is set to reach a new milestone this week. On Wednesday, the probe will be roughly 16 billion miles from Earth.
